options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Allow Selling in Store
options.doc:
Choose if attacks and special attacks should be able to be sold after getting a location check from them.

If disabled, after purchasing something in the store that can be sold, its value will be set to 0.

Items and chips can't be sold.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez si les attaques et les attaques spéciales devraient pouvoir être vendues après avoir obtenu une vérification de leur emplacement.

Si désactivé, après avoir acheté quelque chose dans le magasin qui peut être vendu, sa valeur sera réglée à 0.

Les articles et les jetons ne peuvent pas être vendus.

options.name: Shuffle VLogs
options.doc:
Shuffles the VLogs scattered around Vandelay campus into the multiworld.

VLogs in the SPECTRA Hub Room and Vandelay Gameworks areas are not randomized.
